title: understanding disagreement between humans and machines in xai: robustness, fidelity, and region-based explanations in automatic neonatal pain assessment
core_idea: Introduce a region-based explanation framework and a multi-metric evaluation protocol that jointly considers robustness, faithfulness, and agreement to improve interpretability and guide explainer selection for automatic neonatal pain assessment, with the aim of understanding human–machine disagreement.
tldr: Proposes region-based XAI and a joint robustness/faithfulness/agreement evaluation to support interpretable and actionable explainer selection in neonatal pain classification.
